description.en:
Yanshee is UBTECH's programmable humanoid for AI and robotics education. Its compact body combines a Raspberry Pi-based computing platform with articulated movement, visual and voice interaction, and connections for additional sensors. It is designed for students and researchers to link programming with physical experiments.

Developer resources support graphical programming, Python and other languages, with APIs for robot control and sensing. The platform can be used to explore image recognition, speech interaction, motion and environmental measurements. Capabilities depend on the installed software, sensor modules and course or research configuration.
